content: Isa Akemba Sapulu Rua Mia Rasulu
Saangu wakutuu o Isa akembamo sapulu rua miaia murina tee adhawuakea kuasa to manga incia mamudhaakana amembali apadhencu rohi madhaki tee apaunto sagala giuna panyaki tee manga mia mokakuranga.
Siimo o sarona sapulu rua miaia manga rasulu sumai: Simon isarongiaka uka Petrus, tee witinaina mokosaroakana Andreas, kasiimpo Yakub bin Zabdi tee witinaina mokosaroakana Yahya.
Filipus tee Bartolomeus, Tomas tee Matius moenena balasitee, Yakub bin Alfeus, tee Tadeus.
Kasiimpo Simon mia moewaakana lipuna Israel,
tee Yudas Iskariot mia mohianatina Isa naile itu.
Isa Alamboko Sapulu Rua Mia Rasulu
Kasiimpo Isa alamboko sapulu rua mia murina sumai tee aposamea i manga incia, "Bholi ulingka i lipuna mia mencuana Yahudi tee uka bholi upesua i manga kotana miana Samaria.
Maka ulingkamo i manga dumba momambuu minaaka i uumatina Israel.
Lingkamo tee upakoleleakamea to manga incia, ande o 'Pamarintana Aulataʼala amakasumo.'

Pauntoa manga mia momapii, padhadhia manga mia momate, pekangkiloa manga mia mokopanyakina kuli dhaa, tee upadhencua manga seetani. Ingkomiu utarima kuasa incia sii inda upomeaia, rampaakanamo sumai ingkomiu tabeana ulingka tee upewau giu mopokana to manga mia mosagaanana tee bholi uemani ponambo.
Bholi ubhawa doi bulawa, doi pera atawa doi tambaga i nuncana kadhu-kadhuna kamandamiu.
Bholi ubhawa tasina bhaku i nuncana lingkaamiu, bholi ubhawa rua pasa pakea, tee bholi ubhawa sandali atawa o katuko roonamo mia mokarajaa alaenga apotibhaaka ponambona.
Ande upesua i saangu kota atawa i kampo, peelomo mia moundana motarimakomiu, kasiimpo umbooremo iwe sumai sampe akawa eona to ulingka tee ubholi tampa incia sumai.
Wakutuuna upesua i nuncana bhanuana mia, uposalamu porikana i mokobhanuana.
Ande o miana bhanua sumai aunda atarimakomiu, sumaimo kabarakati minaaka i ingkomiu bheanamisia uka manga incia, maka ande amendeukomiu, sumaimo kabarakatimiu sumai bheambuli pendua i karomiu.
Ande dhaangia o mia momendeukomiu tee inda aperangoi pogaumiu, tantamakamea o ngawu minaaka i aemiu wakutuuna bheulingka minaaka i bhanua atawa minaaka i kota incia sumai.
Satotuuna, Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu, i eona kiaamati o hisabu mosapona i bhawona kota Sodom tee Gomora
bhealabhi o kagaa-gaana minaaka i hisabu bhemosapona i bhawona kota incia sumai."
Kanarakaa Bheinamisina Manga Murina
"Kamatea, Iaku kulambokokomiu mboomo dumba i tanga-tangana serigala, rampaakanamo sumai ingkomiu tabeana ukoʼakala mboomo ulo tee amakate o ngangarandamiu mboomo jarajara.
Maka ukoengati, roonamo dhaangia manga mia bhemopasaraakaakana ingkomiu i manga majilisina agama Yahudi, tee ingkomiu bheutosikisaa i tampana ibaadatina manga incia.
Rampaakanamo Iaku, ingkomiu bheutobhawa i aroana manga gubernuru tee manga raja to umembali sakusiiku i aroana manga incia tee i aroana manga lipu mosagaanana mencuana Yahudi.
Ande manga incia apasaraakakomiu, bholi umaeka tee opea bheipogauakamiu, roonamo i wakutuu incia sumai uka bheapaumbaakakomiu opea to ipogauakamiu.
Roonamo mencuanamo ingkomiu bhemopogauna i wakutuu incia sumai, maka o Rohina Amamiu modhaangiana i nuncana karomiu mopogauna.
Mia bheapasaraakaaka witinaina karona to atopekamate, tee samia ama bheapasaraakaaka anana. Tee manga anana bheaewangi mancuanana tee bheapasaraakaakea mamudhaakana atopekamate.
Bhari-bharia mia bheabancikomiu rampaakanamo saroku, maka incema-incema mopotaangina tee aoseaku sakawana kapadhaana kanarakaa incia sii, sumaimo incia bheasalaamati.
Ande manga incia asikisaakomiu i saangu kota, palaimo i kota mosagaanana. Roonamo satotuuna kupaumbakomiu, indapo upadha umbeliki bhari-bharia kotana Israel, o Anana Maanusia aumbamo.
Samia muri inda akolabhi tee guruna, tee samia bhatua inda akolabhi tee mokobhanuana.

Amalapemo to samia muri ande amembali apokana tee guruna, atawa samia bhatua amembali apokana tee opuna. Jadi ande Iaku ibaratina opu mokobhanuana asarongiakea Baalzebul mokapalana manga seetani, ntaranamo uka tee ingkomiu manga mia i nuncana bhanuaku!
Rampaakanamo sumai bholi umaeka i manga incia, roonamo opea itutubhi bheatobungkale, tee opea ibuniaka bheatomatau.
Opea ipogauakaku tee ingkomiu i nuncana kalalanda, pakawaakea o hali incia sumai i nuncana kainawa, tee opea ipokamuntuiakaku i talingamiu, pakoleleakea i mia bhari minaaka i padhana bhanuamiu.
Bholi umaeka tee manga incia momembalina mopekamatena bada, maka inda kapoia to apekamatea rohi. Salabhina umaeka i Incia mokuasaina tee mopabinasana rohi tee bada i nuncana narakaa.

Bhari-bharia mia amataua o harahagaana rua mbaa ntomintomi amembali atoaso tee satibha doi momaidhiidhi! Maka moomini mboo sumai, inda sambaa uka minaaka i manu-manu sumai amembali akotibu i tana ande inda apeelua o Amamiu.
Bhari-bharia bulua modhaangiana i bhaamiu uka atogagari.
Sababuna sumai bholi umaeka, roonamo ingkomiu alabhi ukoharagaa minaaka i ntomintomi abhari.
Incema-incema moʼakuiaku i aroana maanusia, Iaku uka bhekuʼakuia i aroana Amaku i sorogaa.
Maka incema-incema inda moʼakuiaku i aroana maanusia, Iaku uka inda bhekuʼakuia i aroana Amaku i sorogaa."
Mencuana Kasanaa maka o Poewangia
"Bholi uabhia ande kuumba i dunia sii to kubhawa udhadhi upomalape. Iaku kuumba mencuana to kubhawa udhadhi upomalape, maka kubhawa ewanga.
Roonamo kuumba to kupapogaa ana umane minaaka i amana, ana bhawine minaaka i inana, tee ana mania bhawine minaaka i ina maniana.
Tee musuna samiana satotuuna manga mia i nuncana bhanuana karona.
Incema-incema alabhi amaasiaka amana tee inana minaaka i Iaku, atawa alabhi amaasiaka anana umane tee anana bhawine minaaka i Iaku, sumaimo incia inda alaenga to amembali muriku.
Incema-incema momendeuna mosodhana kau salibna tee aose Iaku, sumaimo incia inda alaenga to apobhawa tee Iaku.
Incema-incema mopotaangiakana inyawana, incia bheakailanga inyawana, maka incema-incema mokailangana inyawana rampaakanamo Iaku, incia bheapokawaaka dhadhi mobakaa.
Incema-incema mopepagokomiu, incia apepago Iaku, tee incema-incema mopepagoaku, incia apepago Incia molambokoaku.

Incema-incema mopepagona samia nabii tee aabhia mboomo samia nabii, incia bheapotibhaaka fahala mboomo kaogena fahala ipotibhaakana samia nabii, tee incema-incema mopepagona mia mosaalihi roonamo kataʼatina, incia bheapotibhaaka fahala mboomo kaogena fahala ipotibhaakana mia mosaalihi.

Tee incema-incema mopekadhawuakana uwe isumpuna moomini soo satonde uwe magari to mia momaidhiidhi sii roonamo incia moosena Iaku, sumaimo Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu, satotuuna incia dhaanamo bheapotibhaakea o fahalana."

footnotes.text: Dhaangiapo uka manga kaburi momangengena apogau kooni, "Lebaeus isarongiakana Tadeus".
Simon sii aose sarambonga raʼeatina Israel moʼusahaakana mamudhaakana lipuna Israel inda akuasaia pamarintana Roma.
Sodom tee Gomora: siitumo rua kota mopewauna madhaki i zamani Nabii Ibrahim tee aahirina apahancurua tee waa masodhona mpuu minaaka i Aulataʼala. Kamatea Bhaa. 19:28.
